methodology: Cases derived from the 'Resume Data for Ranking' Kaggle dataset (real dataset). Relevance here comes from the dataset's own match_label column, a different methodology from data/eval_labels.json's hand-authored judgments — kept in a separate file rather than merged so the two label sources are never silently conflated into one metric. These cases reference resume text and job TITLES directly (not this project's internal candidate_id/job_id), since they weren't ingested into the running system's store — a harness wanting to evaluate against them would first POST each resume_text to /candidates/resume and match job titles to ingested job_ids.
